_comment: D1 -- a CDN that signs in the URL PATH (key=<sig>,end=<epoch>,ip=<client ip>) left the signature, the expiry and the operator's public IP in operator-visible evidence. Every anchor here is structural: no digit, no quoted value and no '=' character, so the row357 anchor gate classifies each as non-value-bearing without a producer record.
subject: the path-assignment redaction rule removes signature/expiry/client-IP from a path-signed URL in both redactors, without destroying the URL's identity

mutants.label: D1-M1 the shared path-assignment substitution is a no-op
mutants.new: return text or _PATH_ASSIGNMENT_RE.sub(  # mutant: the rule never substitutes

mutants.label: D1-M2 the free-string path-run scanner is a no-op
mutants.new: return text or _PATH_SIGNING_RUN_RE.sub(  # mutant: no path run is scanned

mutants.label: D1-M3 redact_media_url stops applying the rule to its path segments
mutants.new: segment  # mutant: the signing segment is passed through

mutants.label: D1-M4 redact_value stops applying the rule
mutants.new: out  # mutant: the derivation boundary skips path signing

mutants.label: D1-M5 the rule masks the whole segment and destroys the URL's identity
mutants.new: PLACEHOLDER  # mutant: mask every assignment-bearing segment wholesale

mutants.label: D1-M6 the rule stops being name-driven and redacts benign assignments
mutants.new:
def _assignment_name_is_sensitive(name: str) -> bool:
    return True  # mutant: every path assignment name reads as sensitive
